A deep, resonant concert bass drum and orchestral timpani provide heavy, syncopated accents. Brass sections, specifically trombones and horns, enter with swelling crescendos and sharp, accented stabs. High-register violins execute rapid spiccato runs and tremolo textures. A grand piano performs low-octave rhythmic doubling of the bass line. The piece utilizes a minor key, likely D minor, with frequent use of dissonant intervals and chromatic clusters in the woodwinds to build suspense. The percussion section expands to include metallic hits and anvil strikes during peak intensity. The structure follows a linear build, increasing in harmonic density and volume through the addition of layered horn counter-melodies and rapid-fire snare rolls.

High-pass filtered noise sweeps rise and fall every eight bars. A distorted snare-like noise hit occurs on beats two and four, layered with a short, metallic reverb tail. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on timbral evolution and rhythmic density rather than melodic progression.
